lesson.simple_rocket.title: Simple Rocket
lesson.simple_rocket.summary: Watch a rocket come together, then draw it yourself from a tall body, balanced fins and a bright flame.
lesson.simple_rocket.step.body_and_nose: Watch the long rocket body first, then see how two slanting lines make the pointed nose.
lesson.simple_rocket.help.body_hint: Keep the body tall and narrow, like a standing capsule.
lesson.simple_rocket.step.window_and_fin: Next, watch the round window and the two fins appear on opposite sides.
lesson.simple_rocket.step.flame: Finish by watching three quick flame lines stretch below the rocket.
lesson.simple_rocket.help.flame_hint: Let the flame point away from the rocket so it feels like it is blasting upward.
lesson.simple_rocket.complete.drawing: Launch complete! You watched, remembered and built your own rocket.
